root_cause.text: The `skb_try_coalesce()` function fails to propagate the `SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG` flag from the source `sk_buff` to the destination `sk_buff` when transferring paged fragments, causing downstream components like ESP to incorrectly assume the fragments are not shared and perform unsafe in-place modifications.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `to_shinfo->flags |= from_shinfo->flags & SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG;` in `net/core/skbuff.c` to address the CVE description stating that "the shared-frag marker is currently lost," which leads ESP to "decrypt in place over page-cache backed frags" because `skb_has_shared_frag()` returns false.
